newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican police stuff suspect in trunk of patrol car.
newsitem.headline: Mexican police stuff suspect in trunk of patrol car.

text.p: Two Mexican policemen on Tuesday gave new meaning to putting a lid on crime.

A helicopter from national television network Televisa filmed them stuffing a suspected highway robber into the trunk of their patrol car because he did not fit into the back seat, which was already crowded with four other suspects.

The patrol car drove off the wrong way down a one-way street, a main highway entering Mexico City. But when the helicopter followed, the car stopped and the handcuffed suspect was removed from the trunk.
One policeman then demonstrated to the television camera that the trunk was empty.
"They're posing," Televisa anchorman Abraham Zabludovsky exclaimed.
It was not clear why some of the five suspects arrested were not taken in other patrol cars.
Their decision to take the fifth man out of the trunk came too late. Transit Police Chief Antonio Arizpe called Televisa to say the two policemen would be fired.
